items.title: Vim Modeline Bypass Vulnerability Let Attackers Execute Arbitrary OS Commands
items.description: A newly discovered high-severity vulnerability in the popular Vim text editor exposes users to arbitrary command execution on the operating system. Tracked as CVE-2026-34982, the flaw relies on a modeline sandbox bypass that triggers when a victim opens a specially crafted file. items.title: Public PoC Exploit Released for Nginx-UI Backup Restore Vulnerability
items.description: A critical security flaw has been disclosed in the Nginx-UI backup restore mechanism, tracked as CVE-2026-33026. This vulnerability allows threat actors to tamper with encrypted backup archives and inject malicious configurations during the restoration process. With a public Proof-of-Concept (PoC) exploit now available, unpatched deployments are at immediate risk of full system compromise.…

items.title: Microsoft to Remove EXIF Data for Images Shared on Teams
items.description: In a significant move to enhance corporate privacy and operational security, Microsoft has announced an important update for its Teams platform. As part of the March 2026 feature rollout, Microsoft Teams will now automatically remove EXIF metadata from all images shared across chats and channels.
